svg.title: Smell over the whole floor
svg.desc: The settled mean receptor reading over the floor at three food densities, from the world's air on its grid (odour.rs, air.rs), risers as walls: white is saturated (0.9 or more), where an orb's own gradient has almost no range left.
svg.text: Smell over the whole floor: every orb its own peak
Settled field (2 min in), mean reading over the 8 receptor types at nose height, one sample per 2 m; palest: 0.9 or more
Five decades of receptor affinity (#76): with every orb summed, each orb still stands out as a peak a body can climb to, even at the densest setting.
